prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a rear-end collision in League City, Texas, and has back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1464; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just leave that out of the recording, if that's okay.
Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where you were when the collision occurred?
A: I was driving on the main road in League City, heading toward the shopping center. Traffic had slowed down ahead of me, so I was stopped at a light.
Q: What happened next?
A: The car behind me didn't stop in time. I felt a hard jolt from behind and my head snapped forward and then back against the seat.
Q: Did you get out of your vehicle at the scene?
A: Yes, but I didn't feel right. My lower back was hurting and I had a stiff feeling in my neck.
Q: Did you seek medical attention?
A: I went to an urgent care clinic later that day. They checked me over and said I had a back strain. They gave me some muscle relaxers and told me to rest.
Q: Have you had any follow-up treatment since then?
A: I've been going to physical therapy twice a week. The pain comes and goes, and it's worse when I sit for long periods or lift anything heavy.
Q: Were you able to keep working after the accident?
A: I've had to take some time off. Sitting at my desk for a full day makes the back pain much worse.
Q: Is there anything else you think I should know about the collision?
A: Only that I was stopped completely when it happened. I wasn't on my phone or doing anything unusual. I just want to get better and get this settled.
Q: Thank you. I'll follow up with you about your medical records and any documentation for missed work.
A: Okay, thank you.
